name: devota
description: Signed OTA for both ESP images (device contract v3): the release manifest, its RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 signature, the strictly-newer version gate, the heartbeat's ota offer grammar, staged-image verification and the probation that keeps or rolls back a new image. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for AVR, Xtensa and host.
keywords: device, ota, firmware update, signature, rsa, embedded
